description: Compile a bounded capability subgraph into an open learning mission with observable artifacts, agent-assistance disclosure, recovery paths, and assessment-ready evidence.

positive: A capability graph must become a real project, studio brief, lab, or apprenticeship task.
A learner needs the smallest mission capable of producing evidence for a target capability set.
negative: The request is only to outline lessons, lectures, or reading lists.
The beneficiary, artifact, evaluator, or evidence threshold cannot yet be named.

procedure.instruction: Select the smallest connected target capability subgraph and make its prerequisite closure explicit.
procedure.proof: Every selected node is necessary for the learner-visible outcome.

procedure.instruction: Define the beneficiary, problem, accountable human, success event, timebox, constraints, stop conditions, and free execution path.
procedure.proof: The mission contract can be accepted or rejected without hidden context.

procedure.instruction: Specify observable artifacts, checkpoints, provenance capture, assistance disclosure, and required human decisions.
procedure.proof: Every target capability maps to at least one artifact claim and evidence event.

procedure.instruction: Compose the minimum bounded agent team and downgrade every unjustified persistent role to a skill or temporary worker.
procedure.proof: An Agent Team Manifest or explicit no-agent decision records the authority boundary.

procedure.instruction: Dry-run the happy path, failure path, prompt-injection path, privacy breach, recovery route, and incomplete evidence path.
procedure.proof: A validation report exposes every unresolved blocker before execution.

inputs: Versioned capability graph and target node set
Learner baseline, constraints, consent, and available tools
Real or simulated beneficiary and accountable human
Artifact, rubric, evidence, recovery, and appeal requirements
outputs: Agent Team Manifest or no-agent receipt
